findings.summary: Module-level WeakMap side table to re-derive the Eddy text from a minted error; works (identity is preserved through the walk, eddy carrier proves it), but passing the source kind into fetchCtx would avoid a second state owner. Taste.

N4 (NOTE): the walk stops at the first missing substitute, so with several cold shadow pins only the first is named; the exits stay true for all, but a reader restoring bytes would learn of the next pin only on retry.

The disk text ('cannot be reinstalled exactly here') is also what a direct @riftydev/npm-client install() caller gets; such a host can seed its own tarball cache. Outside the manager's two named readers, so advisory.

The Eddy text is carried exactly at installer level only; the one surface that reaches Eddy (package-authority terminal with resolverUrl) has no carrier printing `npm: <eddy text>`. The mapping keys on reason and is carried for the disk text, so the gap is a composition, not an untested branch.
noCoiTerminal still re-implements the toolchain owner's install hook; the real owner hook is covered only by the packed Chromium proof (CI light 1/8).
